name: runlight/runlight
description: Privacy friendly web analytics that lives inside your PHP app. Mount a route, add a script tag, read your stats at /runlight.

suggest.ext-pdo_mysql: For the MySQL and MariaDB store
suggest.ext-apcu: Keeps the tracker's rate limit in shared memory rather than files
suggest.symfony/http-foundation: For Runlight\Bridge\HttpFoundation in Laravel and Symfony, which already have it
